name: smartroad
description: SmartRoad: An Intelligent Web-Based Road Safety, Traffic Incident Management and Risk Prediction System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run install:ml
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,ml -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node scripts/ml.js serve"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run ml:test
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
